program:
app "Car service" car slate
table service done_on date = today, odometer num 0.., cost money, garage text
setting every_km num = 7500 "Service every (km)"
setting every_months num = 6 "Service every (months)"
setting odo num = 0 "Current odometer (km)"
let due_km = last(service.odometer) + every_km
let due_date = addmonths(last(service.done_on), every_months)
"Next service at" due_km "km or" due_date head
if(odo >= due_km - 500, "Service is due very soon. Km left:", "Km to next service:") due_km - odo big color if(odo >= due_km - 500, warn, good)
when odo >= due_km - 500 notify "Service due within 500 km"
button "Update odometer" tap edit odo
form service, "Log service"
list service by day
describe:
Car service, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- service: done on: date, starts at today; odometer: number, at least 0; cost: money; garage: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Service every (km)": number, starts at 7500; "Service every (months)": number, starts at 6; "Current odometer (km)": number, starts at 0.
Works out:
- due km is the latest odometer of service plus every km.
- due date is the latest done on of service moved by every months months.
Shows:
- text: "Next service at", due km, "km or", due date.
- text: "Service is due very soon. Km left:" when odo is at least due km minus 500, otherwise "Km to next service:", due km minus odo.
- when odo is at least due km minus 500, it shows the notice "Service due within 500 km".
- a button "Update odometer"; a tap opens odo for editing.
- a form to add a service.
- a list of service by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words
order: start with who it is for

app "Workouts" dumbbell mint
table workout kind pick Run|Gym|Yoga|Walk = Run
state m date = today
monthnav m
grid 7 gap 1
  each ["M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S"] as w
    w tiny color muted align center
  each 1..weekday(m - monthday(m) + 1) - 1
    box
  each days month of m as d
    stack height 44 radius 6 pad 1 fill soft
      monthday(d) tiny
      row gap 0
        each workout on d
          draw width 10
            circle 50, 50, 40 fill if(it.kind = Run, accent, if(it.kind = Gym, good, if(it.kind = Yoga, warn, bad)))
row gap 1
  each options workout.kind
    button "+" it tap add workout kind = it
describe:
Workouts, in the mint colours.

- workout: kind: one of Run, Gym, Yoga, Walk, starts at Run. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- a grid of 7 columns:
  - for "M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S":
    - text: the value.
  - for each number from 1 to the weekday number of m minus the day of the month of m plus 1 minus 1:
  - for each day in the month of m:
    - text: the day of the month of the day.
    - for each workout on the day:
      - a drawing made of circles.
- for each choice of the kind of the workout:

program:
app "Zakat and tip" calc slate
setting cash money = 0 "Cash and bank"
setting gold num = 0 "Gold (grams)"
setting silver num = 0 "Silver (grams)"
setting gold_rate money = 0 "Gold price per gram"
setting silver_rate money = 0 "Silver price per gram"
setting debts money = 0 "Debts due now"
state bill money = 0
state tip num = 10
state people num = 1
let wealth = cash + gold * gold_rate + silver * silver_rate - debts
let nisab = 612.36 * silver_rate
screen zakat "Zakat" coin
  field cash
  field gold
  field silver
  field gold_rate
  field silver_rate
  field debts
  if(wealth >= nisab, "Zakat due (2.5%)", "Below nisab: no zakat due") faint
  round(if(wealth >= nisab, wealth * 0.025, 0)) big
screen split "Tip" calc
  field bill "Bill"
  "Tip" tip "%" faint
  slider tip 0..30
  "People" people faint
  slider people 1..20
  "Tip" round(bill * tip / 100) head
  "Each pays" round(bill * (1 + tip / 100) / people) big
describe:
Zakat and tip, in the slate colours.
You can change: "Cash and bank": money, starts at 0; "Gold (grams)": number, starts at 0; "Silver (grams)": number, starts at 0; "Gold price per gram": money, starts at 0; "Silver price per gram": money, starts at 0; "Debts due now": money, starts at 0.
Works out:
- wealth is cash plus gold times gold rate plus silver times silver rate minus debts.
- nisab is 612.36 times silver rate.
Remembers while you use it: bill, starting at 0; tip, starting at 10; people, starting at 1.
Shows:
- a screen "Zakat":
  - a box to fill in cash.
  - a box to fill in gold.
  - a box to fill in silver.
  - a box to fill in gold rate.
  - a box to fill in silver rate.
  - a box to fill in debts.
  - text: "Zakat due (2.5%)" when wealth is at least nisab, otherwise "Below nisab: no zakat due".
  - text: wealth times 0.025 when wealth is at least nisab, otherwise 0 rounded.
- a screen "Tip":
  - a box to fill in bill, labelled "Bill".
  - text: "Tip", tip, "%".
  - a slider for tip from 0 to 30.
  - text: "People", people.
  - a slider for people from 1 to 20.
  - text: "Tip", bill times tip divided by 100 rounded.
  - text: "Each pays", bill times the result of 1 plus tip divided by 100 divided by people rounded.
